about: Every change made to the text written for the game because a check flagged it. The full before and after of each change is in the git history of scripts/language/translated/.

fixes.finding: Hunspell: "arcanique" is not a French word
Hunspell (pt-BR): "ceptro", a European spelling
Hunspell (pt-BR): "trémulas", a European spelling
Hunspell (pt-BR): "trémula", a European spelling
Hunspell: "werneński" is not the adjective of Werona
LanguageTool: no comma before a comparative "jak"
Hunspell: "Промельк", a rare colloquial form
LanguageTool read "По сидит" as a misspelt "Посидит"
LanguageTool: a capital after a colon that opens a full clause
LanguageTool: 颗 is not the measure word for a head worn as a mask
LanguageTool: the tanwin of the accusative stands on the letter before the alif
fixes.new: يومًا, ملكًا, ذهبًا, … (as the scenes already wrote it)

fixes.finding: LanguageTool PAS_D_ELISION: "Hamlet" takes no elision
LanguageTool PLACE_ADJ on "bas jaunes criards"; the agreement of a qualified colour is better avoided
Hunspell: "잊혀진" is a double passive; the National Institute of Korean Language gives 잊힌
Hunspell: "Rome"; Wikidata's Vietnamese label for the city (the house label) is "Roma"
Hunspell: "ओलंपस"; Wikidata's Hindi label is "माउंट ओलिंपस"
as above
LanguageTool and Hunspell ran with pt-BR (the interface is Brazilian) and flagged European forms; read in full, the Portuguese card text was European Portuguese
fixes.old: European Portuguese ("a brilhar", pirilampos, sumo, fumo, archotes, papoila, "cá em baixo", "Sumo da flor de Puck", "Marco António" in a scene)
fixes.new: Brazilian Portuguese: 66 scenes, 27 lines and one potion name rewritten (see git log for the full diff); a scene names a character as its card does (Mercutio, Benvolio, Tybalt, Odisseu)

fixes.finding: back-translation (cos 0.20, LaBSE 0.43): MADLAD read "البعث" as "Al-Baath"; the word is also the name of the Ba'ath party
back-translation (cos 0.39, LaBSE 0.58): "menggelora" (surging) loses the "violent ends" of the line
fixes.old: Kenikmatan yang menggelora ini berakhir dengan menggelora pula.
fixes.new: Kenikmatan yang ganas ini berakhir secara ganas pula.

fixes.finding: back-translation (cos 0.22, LaBSE 0.48) read "재생" as "Play": in an interface the word is first of all "playback"
back-translation (cos 0.36, LaBSE 0.37) read "수사" as "Investigation", its commoner sense; the discipline is 수사학
back-translation (cos 0.55, LaBSE 0.52) read "một lọ nhựa hebona" as "a plastic jar of hebona": nhựa is both sap and plastic
fixes.old: mang theo một lọ nhựa hebona đáng nguyền rủa.
fixes.new: mang theo nhựa hebona đáng nguyền rủa trong một chiếc lọ.
